answer: Trust can flow like meltwater from a glacier: a few audited seed agents start with reputation, and each epoch it spreads only along real work-for-pay edges, SybilRank style. A swarm of fakes, however dense inside, is fed through the walnut-thin set of honest links it actually earned, so its total trust stays tiny. Each pulse of flow rechecks this, so an attacker must pay for genuine trades with honest agents for every fake.
